messages.subject: R/RStudtio failing to run Hadoop Streaming job.
parts:
R Version: 3.2.2 (Installed on Windows 7)

RStudio: 0.99.484 (Installed on Windows 7)

Hadoop Version : HDP 2.3.2 (Installed on Linux)

 

 

C:\Hadoop\bin> .\yarn jar C:\Hadoop\share\hadoop\mapreduce\hadoop-mapreduce-examples-2.7.1.2.3.0.0-2557.jar wordcount RFiles.txt out1.txt

But i am getting below errors while trying to run an example MR job from R studio

2. mapreduce(

  map = function(k, v) cbind(v, v^2))
